description: Device relay frames and tools (spec §9.7). Frames are canonical-JSON text WebSocket frames of at most max_bytes UTF-8 bytes (a binary frame is refused). parseRelayFrame(text, {max_bytes}): size; canonical cjson; v = 1 (unsupported_version); type in {hello, ready, reauth, call, result}; exact keys per type: hello {v,type,device_id,vaults (1..16 unique IDs),tools (1..7 unique tool names),ts,sig}; ready {v,type,exp}; reauth {v,type,token,proof} (non-empty strings); call {v,type,call_id,vault_id,tool,args (object),caller {client_id 1..256 and grant_id 1..64 printable ASCII, scopes 1..3 unique of vault-mcp:read|write|use},deadline_ms >= 1}; result {v,type,call_id,ok,sig} plus result (object) when ok is true or error {code} when ok is false, code in {denied, pending_approval, not_found, invalid_args, conflict, unsupported, internal}. Every refusal is bad_request. hello is signed with context "akv1/relay", result with "akv1/relay-result", over the frame without sig, by the device key. verifyHello(frame, {sign_pub, now}): device_id = kid(sign_pub) (forbidden); signature (invalid_signature); |now - ts| <= 60000 (unauthorized). verifyResult(frame, sign_pub): signature (invalid_signature). frames MUST parse; invalid_text MUST fail parseRelayFrame (binary: a binary frame carrying binary_utf8 bytes); invalid_hello and invalid_result MUST fail with expect_error. tool_args and tool_results: parseToolArgs(tool, args) and parseToolResult(tool, result) per the §9.7 table; *_invalid MUST fail with bad_request (a device answers invalid_args); an args object with value_fill uses value = value_fill repeated value_length times.
